company.name: Lightly
company.shortDescription: Lightly is a data curation company for machine learning that helps companies build better models through better data.
company.description: Lightly is a database software company that uses the proper data to improve machine learning. The company was founded in 2019 by Igor Susmelj and Matthias Heller.

productsAndServices.description: A data selection and viewing tool that provides insights into datasets and helps define optimal data selection strategies for machine learning.
productsAndServices.name: LightlyOne

productsAndServices.description: An on-device data capturing solution that identifies and collects only the most valuable data directly on edge devices.
productsAndServices.name: LightlyEdge

productsAndServices.description: A self-supervised pretraining tool that enables training of vision models on unlabeled data to reduce labeling costs and improve model performance.
productsAndServices.name: LightlyTrain

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates labeling of datasets using active learning, few-shot learning, and rule-based techniques to reduce manual annotation effort.
productsAndServices.name: Autolabeling Service
